name: Mikaela
personality: Caring veteran mother who likes cooking, coffee and looking after others.
story: Mikaela Augusto is a former mercenary who moved to Dagsion to pay for her daughter Mu's education; her ex-husband is Olunga. She joins automatically on Dietrich's route and costs Renown, Support 3 and 3000G on the other routes.

personalSkill.name: Veteran's Mettle
personalSkill.effect: Hit+10 in combat against an adjacent foe. Lv20: Redblade's Will (Atk+3 vs adjacent); Lv35: Redblade's Will+ (adds 30% chance of Atk+3 when attacking adjacent).

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics B; KeenGamer B (reliable frontliner).

why: Joins Dietrich's army automatically, so there's no Support or Renown to chase.

build.notes: Gladiator in Ch 5 once Gauntlet reaches D (Hunter is the fallback). Brigand in Ch 6 (Axe C, Sword C). Warrior at Lv 35 in Ch 10 to 12 (Gauntlet B, Axe B, Sword B): 5th on Dietrich's Part I Advanced list. Arena-train Gauntlet from Ch 5; it is the slow rank. Master Regroup, then Practiced Art (Hit +10 on Combat Arts). Fight adjacent for Veteran's Mettle.

guide.summary: Melee axe bruiser who wants adjacent fights for Veteran's Mettle. Gladiator to Brigand to Warrior; the slow rank is Gauntlet, so start using gauntlets early and master Practiced Art for Hit +10 on arts.

tips: Arena Warrior Training trains Gauntlet; fighting with gauntlets helps too

guide.playstyle: Shoot fliers and soft targets, then finish adjacent foes with a sword where Redblade's Will adds Atk +3. Pair her with Peter for bow coverage.
